messages:
maya: quick design poll  pulse next to avatar vs compact token pill on right. goal: convey streaming + surface token totals without clutter. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/tmp/pulse-vs-pill (mock)
jon: pulse is subtle but hides counts. pill is discoverable. prefer pill if we can keep it small. :thinking_face:
sam: engineering note: pill can be keyboard-focusable and expandable. pulse would still need a token region for exact counts. pill wins for actionability.
alisha: accessibility: pill must be reachable via keyboard, have aria-live region for updates, and meet contrast 4.5:1. hover-only expand is not acceptable  must also expand on focus.
maya: proposal: collapsed pill (icon + short rounded count like 1.2k). focus/enter expands to exact breakdown: system / prompt / response / cache badge. expansion instant; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
jon: stop/regenerate: keep separate compact buttons. stop visible during stream, regenerate visible when idle. on mobile collapse regenerate into "..." menu.
sam: runtime events exist: streaming.started, streaming.progress, streaming.ended. debounce UI updates to 300ms; keyboard mappings: Esc = stop, Ctrl/Cmd+R = regenerate.
ulx-snippet: ```js
// simple keyboard hook
doc.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && streamActive) stopStream(); if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r' && (e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)) regen(); });
```
alisha: aria-live advice: use role="status" + aria-live="polite" and debounce to 400ms to avoid screenreader spam. announce final state when stream ends: "Generation complete."
maya: prompt library copy: rename "My prompts" -> "Saved prompts" and empty state text: "Save prompts here for reuse across the workspace."
sam: layout: right rail on desktop, bottom sheet on <900px. will add telemetry hooks ui.token_pill_expand, ui.stop_clicked, ui.regen_clicked.
ux-bot: reminder  create a11y ticket for contrast/focus and include NVDA/VoiceOver test steps.
